preconditions.description: The length of the sequences a and b must be between 1 and 100000.
The boundaries l and r must be within the range from 1 to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(l <= a[i] <= r for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements of sequence a must be within the range from l to r.

preconditions.expression: len(set(p)) == n and all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The compressed sequence p must contain n distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any_valid_b else True
postconditions.description: If no suitable sequence b exists, output '-1'; otherwise, output the elements of sequence b.

postconditions.expression: all(l <= b[i] <= r for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: All elements of the output sequence b must be within the range from l to r.

postconditions.expression: all(c[i] != c[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
postconditions.description: All elements of the calculated sequence c must be distinct.
